application_method: Submit Job Requisition Form with KSUM UID certificate
description: Startups with a valid KSUM UID can avail access to instrumentation services at subsidized rates. For more information on facility access procedures and the exclusive instrumentation rates for KSUM UID startups, refer to the CIF facility information.
